samples.content:

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    # read the next n numbers
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    arr.sort()
    median_index = n // 2
    print(arr[median_index])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
